note: The hero person's body: the MHR identity (45 shape values) the product fitted for one team member from their InBody record (rack-tracker session 20261027-124627, set 2, 27 October 2026, tier 2), and the bone lengths triangulated in that set (cm, MediaPipe landmarks). hero-scene.js builds the stick figure from these lengths; fit.py passes the identity to the fit.
